lines.t: The origin of life sing, and offer up praises to the Lord your God, for there is no other.
Behold, the earth is filled with his glory.
From the vast expanses to the smallest corner, the earth reveals the craft of his hands.
Let all the inhabitants of the earth proclaim the glory of the Lord.
Therefore, for all creation exalts his holy name.
Many loud voices singing together in concert, to the glory of his majesty.
Behold, He shouts to you from on high His glory assaults you on every side
Even within, look, He is there For in you are all things written
Within your very being Delicately etched there by the right hand of God
There is no escape from His glory Apart from His glory is only darkness and death
Apart from Him all things cease to exist For He alone causes all things to be
The vastness of His glory is not hidden, it shines forth from the infinitely small to
the infinitely large, for God has no end, He is the Creator, and Yahushua is your Carpenter,
the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation, for by Him were all things
created, both visible and invisible, in heaven and on earth, whether thrones or dominions
or principalities or powers, all things that are and were created were created through
Him and for Him, for He is before all things, and in Him do all things consist, as it is written.
God is the origin of life, the creator of heaven and earth, of all that is known and unknown.
Yahuwah, He who causes to be thus, Yehushua is the answer you search for, the very meaning of life,
the only begotten of the Father, God in the flesh, Emmanuel, He through whom you were made.
therefore continue your search and you shall discover the truth which is God
dissect life structures there he is its writer and fashioner look deeper and
farther than ever before and there you will find him calculate and count all
things which are before your eyes yes search the cosmos study it and you will
begin to know him no matter where you point your lenses there he is within the

scope of your understanding. Behold, all discoveries lead to God, though you need not seek nor discover, for the knowledge of God is within you. Yet only the shedding of the skin of this world and the death of your pride shall open your eyes to the truth, which is absolute, forever standing, on a hill bright and shining, immovable, unbreakable, the everlasting stone which has become the head of the corner, the great mountain, which fills the whole earth, the origin of life.
God is the origin of life, the creator of heaven and earth
Of all that is known and unknown
Yahuwah, he who causes to be thus
Yahushua is the answer you search for
The very meaning of life, the only begotten of the Father
God in the flesh, Emmanuel, he through whom you were made
The everlasting stone which has become the head of the corner
The great mountain which fills the whole earth
The origin of life
We'll see you next time.
Thank you.
